scripts.setup: npm install --prefix frontend --legacy-peer-deps && npm run setup:backend
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev: start "NovaCRM frontend" cmd /k npm run dev --prefix frontend & start "NovaCRM backend" cmd /k npm run dev:backend
scripts.start: start "NovaCRM frontend" cmd /k npm run start --prefix frontend & start "NovaCRM backend" cmd /k npm run start:backend
